name: MongoShell
description: Interactive MongoDB JavaScript shell in a dedicated GoNavi window: connect with the saved connection, browse databases, and run bounded goja scripts with find, aggregate, insert, update, delete and runCommand.
author: GoNavi

permissionNotes.host.connections.credentials: Reads the saved MongoDB configuration, including credentials, from the launch context. Credentials are used once and never returned.
permissionNotes.host.log: Writes bounded connection diagnostics without credentials.
permissionNotes.ai.skills: Ships the mongo-shell-recipes reference skill document for explicit Agent loading.

commands.title: Connect to the saved MongoDB connection
commands.description: Opens a driver client with the launch-context configuration, verifies it with a bounded ping and returns the database list.

commands.title: Run a JavaScript shell script
commands.description: Executes a goja script with the db helper object, print and use. Results are bounded by maxRows and a command timeout.

connectionActions.title: MongoShell
connectionActions.description: Open a MongoDB JavaScript shell for this connection, database or collection.

skills.name: MongoShell recipes
skills.description: Reference for the bounded MongoShell JavaScript API: connection context, db/collection helpers, row limits, read-only behaviour and safe query patterns.
